title: 第23章 我是强盗毫无道德包袱第24章 终于抢到白银了
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “楚居士，我知道你是有本事的人，你可知天下大势？”
太白金星站定笑道。
“不知道，我只是个强盗！”
这老家伙想用天下大势压他。
开什么玩笑？
他可是一个罄竹难书的强盗。
比底线，比下限是吧？
“还有老头，你到底是谁？没事跑到这里来瞎逛。”
“不知道，这里可是本大王的地盘！”
“雁过拔毛，兽走留皮！”
“胆子不小，敢来这里，你带钱了没有？”
太白金星被这一连串的问题直接问懵了。
对方是一个毫无底线的强盗。
和他谈天下大势？
“大王，你可知取经大事，关乎天下苍生？”
楚云自然知道取经，乃是此番天地间的量劫。
可是这和他又有什么关系？
“什么取经关我屁事？”
“我只是个强盗你有必要考虑天下苍生吗？”
太白金星发现这个天聊不下去了。
对方是一个毫无底线的强盗。
你和他讨论天下苍生？
“老家伙，能不能说点实在的？！”
“没有的话，你少不了这一顿皮肉之苦！”
楚云将饭碗放在桌子上。
太白金星双眼提流乱转，看到了桌子上的饭碗，想到了新的话题。
“大王您吃的这白米饭，你可知这白米饭来之不易？”
“有啥来之不易？这是我从山下村子里抢的。”
打秋风的事情楚云经常干，不过每次都是意思一下就行了。
反正每个月都去。
“老家伙，我再提醒你一句！
要是没啥有用的东西可说，迎接我的怒火吧！”
太白金星也是第1次这么无语。
以他的身份和地位，无论到哪里都是以礼相待。
太白金星，虽然听起来只是一个普通星君。
但是他可是玉皇大帝身边的红人。
也可以说是玉皇大帝的智囊之一。
content_en:
"Jushi Chu, I know you are a capable person. Do you know the general trend of the world?"
Taibai Jinxing stood still and smiled.
"I don't know, I'm just a robber!"
This old guy wants to use the power of the world to suppress him.
Are you kidding me?
He is a robber who knows a lot.
Compared with the bottom line, compared with the lower limit, right?
"And old man, who are you? You came here to hang out for nothing."
"I don't know, this is my king's territory!"
"The geese pluck their feathers when they pass by, but the beasts leave their skin behind when they leave!"
"You are brave enough to come here. Have you brought any money?"
Taibai Jinxing was directly confused by this series of questions.
The other party is a robber with no bottom line.
Talk to him about the general trend of the world?
"My lord, do you know that the important matter of seeking scriptures is related to the people of the world?"
Chu Yun naturally knew that obtaining scriptures was a calamity between heaven and earth.
But what does this have to do with him?
"Why does it have nothing to do with me?"
"I'm just a robber. Do you need to consider the world?"
Taibai Jinxing found that she couldn’t continue chatting this day.
The other party is a robber with no bottom line.
Are you discussing the world with him?
"Old guy, can you tell the truth?!"
"If not, you will inevitably suffer this physical pain!"
Chu Yun put the rice bowl on the table.
Taibai Jinxing's eyes wandered wildly, he saw the rice bowl on the table, and thought of a new topic.
"My lord, the white rice you are eating, do you know that this white rice is hard-earned?"
"What's hard-earned? I snatched this from the village at the foot of the mountain."
Chu Yun often did this to fight against the autumn wind, but he just had to be intentional every time.
Anyway, I go every month.
"Old guy, let me remind you again!
If you have nothing useful to say, welcome my wrath! "
Taibai Jinxing was also speechless for the first time.
Given his identity and status, he treats everyone with courtesy wherever he goes.
Taibai Jinxing, although he sounds like just an ordinary star king.
But he is the famous person next to the Jade Emperor.
It can also be said to be one of the Jade Emperor's think tanks.
